$comment: Human labels from listening, the most trusted description of a sound. From the 2026-10 ear test (the user corrected the tools' pre-filled sheet). measure-sfx merges each entry into manifest.json as `labels`; rcg audio-analyzer never writes here. Energy 1 = very calm, 5 = very intense. Vocals: none, some or lead. kind (music | sfx) overrides the analyzer's guess.

bg-music-autumn-remains.mood: calm, peaceful, a little melancholic; piano, ambient/neo-classical
bg-music-autumn-remains.goodFor: reflective moments, quiet intro, soft story, slow build up, background under voice

bg-music-beyond-the-sea-is-freedom.mood: bittersweet: melancholic yet uplifting and inspiring; dreamy ambient electronic with guitar
bg-music-beyond-the-sea-is-freedom.changes: slight: a touch more uplifting in the first 10 s, more melancholic and ambient by the end
bg-music-beyond-the-sea-is-freedom.goodFor: travel, sea or nature footage, hopeful reflective ending, freedom or new-start theme

bg-music-daily-mail.goodFor: headline news, tech or news feel, mild tension; short sting and looping background music

bg-music-dark-fantasy.mood: tense, suspenseful, mysterious; piano and strings
bg-music-dark-fantasy.goodFor: suspense, mystery, "something's wrong" moment, horror tease

bg-music-feeling-things-i-cant-explain.goodFor: emotional voiceover, reflective story, late-night thoughts, sad stories

bg-music-floating-signal.goodFor: soft intro or outro, lifestyle, gentle loop, mysterious news

bg-music-is-this-the-end.changes: no, the mood holds for all 80 s
bg-music-is-this-the-end.goodFor: regaining yourself after sadness or reflective story, slow montage, long voiceover bed; the only track long enough for a 60 s video

bg-music-levels.mood: calm and spacey, happy and energetic
bg-music-levels.changes: yes: peaceful ambient 0-10 s, then melancholic and eerie 10-15 s
bg-music-levels.goodFor: calm-to-uneasy turn, space or night visuals, flashback or future thoughts

bg-music-mos-6581.goodFor: tech, retro or gaming vibe, calm background

bg-music-reve-brvmes.vocals: some: one artificial vocal word only
bg-music-reve-brvmes.goodFor: edgy hype moment, fast cuts, night city, gaming

bg-music-stranded.mood: ambient, mysterious, a bit sad and epic
bg-music-stranded.goodFor: lonely or contemplative moment, landscape shot

bg-music-tensions-run-high.mood: epic, tense, aggressive; action trailer, drum heavy
bg-music-tensions-run-high.goodFor: trailer, hype reel, countdown, big reveal

bg-music-track-14.mood: relaxed but uplifting, motivational; piano and synth

bg-music-vertigo-insensible.goodFor: sad or emotional beat, quiet ending

vibe-after-party.changes: slight: more electronic first 10 s, then funky and playful
vibe-after-party.goodFor: upbeat lifestyle, party, fun promo, intro or moments with no voiceover; the rap clashes with a voiceover
